class.name: TagContainer
class.brief_description: A container node responsible for holding, tracking, and signaling changes to an entity's gameplay tags.
class.description: [TagContainer] manages active gameplay tags for an entity at runtime. It stores tags as a collection of unique integer IDs [PackedInt32Array] and emits signals whenever tags are added or removed, allowing abilities, effects, and entities to respond dynamically to state changes.

members.member: The array of unique tag IDs currently assigned to and active within this container.

signal.name: tag_added
signal.description: Emitted when a new gameplay tag with the specified [param id] is granted or added to the [param owner].

signal.name: tag_removed
signal.description: Emitted when an active gameplay tag with the specified [param id] is removed or cleared from the [param owner].
